ABLATION: cache-eviction feedback on ART-Chat (Apr 6 15:05-15:35 held-out paper window, time_scale 2.0). Companion to costmodel_wildchat_evictfb_v5, which established the mechanism fires but is routing-neutral on a cache-dead workload (WildChat: 3 real engine hits in 61k requests, phantom credit p50 3 tokens). ART-Chat is where the reviewer's cache-illusion question has teeth: engine logs from prior runs on this stack show 20-30% of requests with real hits, p50 ~6-8k tokens, under KV pool churn.

Two gorgo-2d arms with identical frozen paper weights (w_rtt=0.276, w_queue=0.5, learned on the Apr 5 window per paper v3) differing ONLY in config.trie_eviction_feedback; random as the ambient-variance control. Engines run --enable-cache-report; under the feedback flag a null usage.prompt_tokens_details means zero cached (SGLang emits details only when count > 0). The prediction/actual delta is traced unconditionally in both gorgo arms.

Hypothesis: with real multi-thousand-token hits, an observed eviction revokes credit worth hundreds of score units (vs ~3-40 on WildChat), so feedback should visibly shift routing on conversations whose prefix died -- measure TTFT tails plus illusion frequency/magnitude. Run as a base spec: no tune, no eval chain.
